summary.text: Chinmay Sutar scored 400 off 517 balls for MIZ in their first innings total of 581-9 declared, with Anil Gupta taking 3 for 143. Rongsen Jonathan top-scored with 118 off 226 balls as NGL made 516-10 in reply, facing Khiangte Vanrotlinga who claimed 3 for 99. The match ended in a draw.
